question: Can the fully saved first-card stage support a complete single-decision learning problem without collecting any more games?
scope: First Act first fight final card reward only; all subsequent outside decisions and MCTS stay at the parent. Every original legal card action and family remains. No downstream-relic outcome substitution.
admission: Closed E133 cancellation and preserved hashes required. Complete menus and exact E133 roles, row qualification/original controls, all new branch terminal/state/RNG/NN audits, 42 existing pilot family proofs. Any fault rejects all learning admission, never becomes death. The joint study remains closed.
selection: Complete predefined first-stage cohort, not a successful/completed-family subset of the unfinished relic stage. No seed replacement or label-dependent filtering.
learning_handoff: Root designs and runs early-card learning after this independent single-decision admission succeeds. Source preparation/audit does not evaluate or select a candidate and has no optimizer entry.
limits: 10,072 file presences are only a reuse lead until this audit passes. Old historical holdout is development, not final unseen acceptance. Original-game alignment remains excluded.
